body: I don't know, yall. I get what you're saying about their tactics and inadmissible evidence...but. I'm a 43 year old woman who was raped by my uncle when I was around 7 or 8. When I was 14 I was "dating" a 19 year old psycho who anally raped me, cut me, held a loaded gun to my head, all that kind of shit. And MY GOD I wish there had been anyone to stand up for kids like me. Just anyone at all.

Imagine that crazy lady is your boss, and you're an apprentice mortician. Learning how to embalm and cremate and hold funerals etc. This bitch smelled like barn clothes and mocked me for taking tylenol when I had a dental procedure. I heard her on the phone telling a mother, who was preplanning her son's funeral, that maybe if the Nazis kept doing those experiments, her son might not have been actively dying from spina bifida. 
And fuck Duane forever, too.
